disclosure.statement: Production DNSSEC implementation/evaluator code existed in the repository, but it was not read, imported, executed, or used to derive any expectation. No src/, evaluator output, or parent implementation was consulted. No builds, tests, lint, formatters, or production fixes were run. All findings come from the frozen publication worksheet, the worker plan, publication dispositions, and the frozen numeric fixture objects.

parentGuardCompliance.dns17Note: No patch changes authenticated-rfc9615-bootstrap or parent-policy-declines secure-signaling checks to not-checked/indeterminate. AN-05 is the required additive independently verified out-of-domain material; the secure expected status is preserved.
existingExactCheck: overlap-keysets providerModel1Final3 is [K0,Z1,Zb], not [K0,Z0,Zb]: Z1 != Z0, so it is not an exact match for DNS18 shared/separate g0 checkpoints.
overlap-keysets providerModel1Overlap4 is [K0,Z0,Z1,Zb], not the 3-key shared/separate sets: extra Z1, so it is not an exact match.
provider-shared-dnskey is [K0,Z0,Kb,Zb], not [K0,Z0,Zb] or [Kb,Z0,Zb]: extra KSK, so it is not an exact match.
role-rollover zskOverlap/zskOnlyFinal/kskOverlap/kskOnlyFinal contain no provider-b ZSK/Zb tuple; not exact for DNS18 provider models.
DNS15 revoke can use the existing exact child-anchor-observation [K0,K1,Z0] plus child-anchor-observation-long-signature; no new receipt is requested.
DNS14 unsupported-digest-only can use the existing exact parent-ds-unsupported-digest250 plus its signature; no new digest250 object is requested.
DNS15 provisioned-anchor already has the exact root-dnskey-g1 and root-dnskey-g1-by-ksk objects; the correction is a holder/source declaration, not a new receipt.
DNS18 coordinated-rollover already has exact providerModel1Overlap/Final sets and signatures; the correction is only child-zsk-g2 private custody, not new numeric material.
initialHolderOmissions: DNS15 revoke: A/B already Valid is an authored prior live generation; add B to anchors and add setup.initialTrustObservation using the existing exact child-anchor-observation. Do not add an unshown current-publication receipt.
DNS19 notify-ixfr and zonemd-mismatch: secondaryGeneration g0 / preserved previous g0 are authored prior live generations; add dnsSecondary g0 holdings. No new receipt.
parentGuardCompliance.numericPrivateCustodianDisposition: numeric/dnssec-numeric-fixtures.json generation.privateCustodian is a verification-generator label, not authored runtime custody. Numeric bytes are preserved; worksheet ownership.privateKeys is the runtime custody disposition. No numeric rewrite is requested.

profileChoicesNotDefects: Selected alg13 + DS digest2, NSEC profile, permissive application acceptance of authenticated insecure delegations, and omission of optional EDE are selected profile choices, not input contradictions.
Synthetic 3600/7200/86400 TTLs, 300/600 propagation, 30/35-day RFC5011 hold-down, 90-day outage, and accelerated display clocks are selected teaching timings, not normative defects.
DNS15 management-only outcomes (rcode null, hops [], pending application, no leaf cache/use/stub) are correct for the selected lesson scope and were preserved.

DNS02 key-tag collision candidates, DNS14 dual-algorithm overlap, and DNS18 multi-signer models are required learning shapes; the corrections preserve those shapes and change only missing declarations/bindings.

missingDsDnskeyReceipts.status: analogous gaps found, not a mandate to pre-trust
missingDsDnskeyReceipts.note: The corrections add literal receipts/observations/signatures or explicit authored holder declarations; they do not silently promote a catalog entry or cached copy into trust. The DNS03-style initialCache mismatch itself is absent because all 66 publication cases have setup.initialCache=[].

futureValidatorClockPrerequisiteExpiry.note: Every selected signature ID referenced by a clocked checkpoint is within its inception/expiration window. The only future inception is DNS12:resign-before-expiry www-a-refresh-same-key-new at base+5400, but its checkpoint is base+6000 and the old signature remains valid through base+10000; this is a deliberate refresh sequence, not an expired prerequisite.

wrongOwnerInFetchedAnswer.note: Every applicationResult qname/qtype matches setup.qname/qtype; DNS02:changed-owner intentionally queries other.lab.example. and returns signature-mismatch. No checkpoint/application result presents an answer under the wrong owner.

perContextFailureCacheKeyOmission.note: No failure-cache entries exist in worksheet-publication.json. cacheEntries are positive answer/DNSKEY/DS/delegation entries; therefore there is no per-context failure-cache key to omit. If the effective schema requires failure-cache contexts, they are absent by scope, not inconsistently keyed.

independentSignedDeadlineMetadataInconsi.status: not found as an inconsistency; some cache entries are under-declared
independentSignedDeadlineMetadataInconsi.note: All selectedSignatureBindingsByCase inception/expiration values that are present match the referenced numeric signature objects. DNS12:resign-before-expiry cache signatureExpiresAt=1792723600 matches www-a-refresh-old-expiry10000.expiration. Several DS/DNSKEY cache entries omit signatureExpiresAt (DNS13, DNS16, DNS18); these are insufficient declarations, not wrong deadlines. No signed-deadline object was changed.
